intro: A tough scale harvested from the tallstriders roaming the sweeping plains of Mulgore. It serves as a vital component in a traditional remedy prepared by Maur Raincaller to counter a virulent infection.

p: While plainstriders are best known for their soft feathers and lean meat, their powerful legs are covered in tough, protective scales. These scales are resilient against the harsh scrubland terrain and predator claws. Finding one intact and suitable for medicine requires patience, as only select plainstriders across Mulgore yield scales firm enough to be ground and prepared for folk remedies.
